data.name: Hafi
data.gender_notes: Hafi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Hafi means ‘keeper’, ‘guardian’, or ‘protector’. This name is derived from the root h-f-a, which means ‘to keep’ or ‘to preserve’. In Islamic history, Hafis are known as memorizers and reciters of the Quran. They dedicate their lives to preserving the divine words of Allah and sharing them with others. The name Hafi carries the meaning “Keeper, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hafi usually hope their child will grow to embody keeper, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies commitment and protection.
data.etymology: Hafi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Keeper, Guardian.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hafi total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: حفي
in_arabic.meaning: حفي يعني الشخص الذي يستر ويخفي العيوب
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم حفي مشتق من الجذر ح-ف-ي في اللغة العربية، ويعني الشخص الذي يستر ويخفي العيوب، ويتصف بالحلم والعفاف. في القرآن الكريم، لا يوجد ذكر صريح للاسم حفي، ولكن الجذر ح-ف-ي ذكر في سياق الستر والعفاف. يعتبر اسم حفي من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية وصفات حميدة، مما يجعله محبوبًا في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: حفی
in_urdu.meaning: حفی مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو عیوب کو چھپاتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام حفی عربی جڑ ح-ف-ی سے ماخوذ ہے، جو کہ عیوب کو چھپانے اور خفی رکھنے کے معنی رکھتا ہے۔ یہ نام اردو زبان میں بھی مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیا کے مسلم معاشروں میں۔ اسلامی روایات میں، یہ نام ان شخصیات کے لیے منتخب کیا جاتا ہے جو حلم، عفاف، اور اخلاق کی نمائندگی کرتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: हफ़ी
in_hindi.meaning: हफ़ी मतलब है जो व्यक्ति दोषों को छुपाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम हफ़ी अरबी मूल का है, जिसका अर्थ है दोषों को छुपाना और सुरक्षित रखना। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी प्रचलित है, जहां यह नाम अच्छे गुणों और आदर्शों को दर्शाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए चुना जाता है जो विनम्रता और नैतिकता का प्रतीक होते हैं।

in_pashto.name: حفي
in_pashto.meaning: حفي يعني هغه شخص چې عيوب پټوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: د حفي نوم د عربي ژبې د ح-ف-ي ريښې څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د عيوبو پټولو او محفوظ ساتلو معنی لري. په پښتو کلتور کې، دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چې د عفاف او اخلاقو نمونې دي. دا نوم د افغانستان او پښتونستان په مسلم ټولنو کې دود دی.

in_english.name: Hafi
in_english.meaning: Hafi means one who conceals or hides faults
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hafi originates from the Arabic root 'ḥ-f-y', which means 'to conceal or hide'. In Islamic tradition, Hafi is a name given to individuals who are known for their modesty, forgiveness, and ability to overlook faults. Although not directly mentioned in the Quran, the root 'ḥ-f-y' conveys the sense of protection and covering of flaws. The name Hafi is popular across various Muslim cultures for its positive connotations of humility and moral integrity.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل حفي (HA-fee)

data.cultural_impact: The name Hafi holds a significant cultural impact within the Islamic community as it is associated with the preservation and protection of the Quran. Memorization and recitation have long been valued practices in Islamic tradition, which are essential to the transmission of Islamic knowledge and history. Hafis have held a revered position in Islamic society, especially during the pre-modern era when the written word was less accessible. Their role as preservers and reciters of the Quran helped ensure its faithful transmission through generations. Hafis continue to hold importance in the Islamic world today as symbols of dedication, discipline, and knowledge.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Hafi holds great spiritual significance as it represents the commitment to preserve and protect the divine words of Allah. Memorizing and reciting the Quran is considered a sacred act in Islam. It is a way for individuals to connect deeply with the divine and gain a greater understanding of the teachings of the noble Quran. The spiritual journey of a Hafi is a lifelong one, requiring unwavering dedication, patience, and perseverance. As a preserver of the Quran, a Hafi plays an essential role in preserving the connection between the present generation and those of the past, ensuring the continuation of Islamic knowledge and tradition.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Hajar Al-Haytami (d. 1542): A prominent Islamic scholar and author of the 'Hadhratul Hafiz' treatise on the science of hadith. The term 'Hafiz' (pl. 'Huffaz') refers to a person who has memorized the entire Quran.

Hafiz Ibn Al-Wadih Al-Qastallani (d. 1498): An Andalusian scholar and author of the 'Irshad al-Sari li-Sharh Sirr al-Asrar'. This work is renowned for its detailed explanations of the symbolic meanings of the letters and numbers in the Quran.

trends: Gaining popularity in Western Muslim communities
